# Magic Checkout APIs

You can use the following APIs related to Magic Checkout:
- **Coupon Code**: Use the [Coupon Code APIs](https://razorpay.com/docs/build/llm-docs/payments/magic-checkout/apis/coupon-code.md) to send coupon details to Razorpay. Razorpay will create the coupon codes, which you can then apply to transactions.
- **Customer Address**: Use the [Customer Address APIs](https://razorpay.com/docs/build/llm-docs/payments/magic-checkout/apis/customer-address.md) to upload customers' billing and shipping addresses in bulk. 
- **Shipping Information**: Use the [Shipping Information APIs](https://razorpay.com/docs/build/llm-docs/payments/magic-checkout/apis/shipping-info.md) to send the customer's shipping information to Razorpay.
